claim: Dell Technologies raises its full-year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance above $192.0 billion when it reports third-quarter results after the US close on Tuesday 24 November 2026.

runs.scenario: If Dell reaffirms guidance already above $192.0 billion, the criterion says YES, but the claim’s word “raises” suggests NO. Likewise, a qualifying release before the U.S. market close would satisfy the criterion but not the claim’s “after the US close” wording. The stated criterion controls in both cases.
runs.yes_requires: Dell must publish its fiscal Q3 2027 results on November 24, 2026, Eastern time, within the stated event window. The results release or accompanying guidance must state full-year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance with a range midpoint, or a single figure if no range is given, strictly above $192.0 billion.
runs.decided_by: Dell Technologies’ official fiscal Q3 2027 results release or the guidance published with it, together with the Eastern-time publication timestamp.

runs.yes_requires: Dell Technologies must publish its fiscal Q3 2027 results on Tuesday, November 24, 2026 (US Eastern time), and the results press release or accompanying published guidance must state a full-year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance midpoint (or single point figure) strictly greater than $192.0 billion.
runs.decided_by: Dell Technologies' fiscal Q3 2027 results press release and accompanying published guidance materials.

runs.yes_requires: Dell Technologies' fiscal Q3 2027 results press release, or the full-year guidance published with it, is issued on Tuesday 24 November 2026 (US Eastern time) and states full-year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance whose midpoint—or single point figure if no range is given—is strictly above $192.0 billion.
runs.decided_by: The wording of Dell Technologies' official fiscal Q3 2027 results press release and any full-year revenue guidance published with that release.
